item.title: PIL in Supreme Court against false FIRs
item.description: The plea, filed by advocate Ashwini Kumar Upadhyay through advocate-on-record Ashwani Kumar Dubey, contended that such preventive measures are essential to secure the right to life, liberty and dignity of innocent citizens guaranteed under Article 21 of the Constitution.

item.title: Speeding car mows down elderly man in Delhi’s Ghazipur; driver held
item.description: "Today, at about 6 a.m., a PCR call regarding a fatal road accident was received at Ghazipur police station and later transferred to PIA police station. The accident took place near a petrol pump on the service road of NH-24 in Ghazipur village," the police statement said.

item.title: Pappu Yadav thanks supporters after bail, targets Bihar govt over ‘failure of governance’
item.description: Independent MP from Purnea, Rajesh Ranjan alias Pappu Yadav, on Saturday, thanked his supporters for standing by him during his time in jail and called upon the people of Bihar to unite for justice, even as he launched a sharp attack on the state government over law-and-order situation.

item.title: At least three killed in plane crash in US Colorado
item.description: The US National Transportation Safety Board said on X that it is investigating the crash of an Epic Aircraft E1000, a single-engine, six-seat turboprop light aircraft, Xinhua news agency reported.

item.title: Chiranjeevi lauds Ramcharan, Upasana for their conscious and spiritually rooted choice of names for their children
item.description: Mega Star Chiranjeevi has now penned a post of appreciation for both Ram Charan and Upasana Konidela for their conscious and spiritually rooted choice of names drawn from "our eternal cultural heritage and sanctified by the blessings of our sacred temples."

item.title: Kerala at ‘rail crossroads’ as CM Vijayan seeks RRTS support, Sreedharan offers rival vision
item.description: Kerala's transport ambitions have entered a decisive phase, with Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, on Saturday, formally seeking the Centre's support to roll out a Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS), even as "Metro Man" E. Sreedharan unveiled a rival railway blueprint, setting the stage for a high-stakes infrastructure debate ahead of the state Assembly elections.

item.title: Tamil Nadu to appoint new industry partners for ‘Naan Mudhalvan’ skill courses in 2026–27
item.description: Chennai: The Tamil Nadu government, on Saturday, decided to appoint new industry and training partners for the academic year 2026–27 under its flagship “Naan Mudhalvan” upskilling initiative, aiming to introduce trending and employment-oriented courses across colleges in the state. The move is intended to strengthen skill development among students pursuing Engineering, Arts and Science, Polytechnic …

item.title: Bomb Threat Email Triggers Panic on Delhi–Hyderabad IndiGo Flight; Turns Out to Be Hoax
item.description: According to airport sources, the threat email claimed that a bomb had been planted on the Delhi–Hyderabad flight. The alert led to heightened tension among passengers and authorities as soon as the aircraft approached Hyderabad.

item.title: Reactor Explosion Triggers Massive Fire at Pharma Unit in Telangana
item.description: According to preliminary reports, the explosion took place on Friday evening, allegedly due to a short circuit in the factory, which led to the reactor blast and subsequent fire. The intensity of the flames was reported to be high, causing panic in the surrounding area.

item.title: RPF Head Constable Saves Passenger from Moving Train at Vijayawada Railway Station
item.description: According to railway officials, the incident occurred on Platform No. 6 after the Cherlapally–Shalimar East Coast Express arrived at the station. As passengers boarded, the train began to move out of the platform.
